summary: Benchmarks closed lower and snapped a two-day winning run; large and midcaps sold off while smallcaps ended slightly higher, so breadth held up better than the headline indices.

detail.leaders: Banks and NBFCs (Kotak, SBI, HDFC Bank, Bajaj Finance); Smallcap 100 +0.30%
detail.tone: The official close was slightly weaker than the closing-auction print: Nifty 22,603.05 (-173.05, -0.76%) and Sensex 72,638.70 (-429.11, -0.59%), just above the day low of 22,578.25.
watch: Brent above $100 and the rupee near 96.6
